== Betrayer Spawn Probabilities ==

[[File:betrayer.png]]

Assuming 1,2,3,4 and 5% spawn probabilities for Betrayer. Assuming 16 minute (RL) respawn timer. Assuming 3 PH's in hall. You may be interested to gather your guild and camp multiple pipes to reduce your total time in camp.

[[File:betrayer2.png]] [[File:betrayer3.png]]

As we approach very high probabilities, there's some artificial jaggedness. This is due to rounding errors, and should not be interpreted with the model.
